name: Riot Skin Disabler (NoSkin)
creator: moga
description:
-

###
For any funny/broken skin/etc, PLEASE notify me so I can fix it!

Use the utility linked below to automatically whitelist entire Champions or specific skins!!
https://github.com/inkyarev/SmallWhitelister4Noskin

### Overview:

**Sets ALL skins to the default skin, so you don't need to learn to dodge 999 different VFX per champ!**

- This mod has to sort to the top (ie, load with the lowest priority) if you want to force a custom skin to load alongside it. The mod is preset to the minimum priority automatically if used with CSLoL-GO.
- YOU **NEED** TO REDOWNLOAD THIS MOD EVERY PATCH! If there is no update for the first few hours of a patch, you are likely ok to use the previous version, but eventually, you will very probably run into broken VFX caused by Riot file changes, or a game crash caused by more important Riot file changes/new skins.
- A ton of broken skins and misc crashes have been fixed since I remade the mod. Malfunctions should be nonexistent or very rare. (Still report anything if u see smth weird plz.)

https://discord.gg/gSXbEmPQCA
